name: conditional_formatting
representative_why: Users need visual emphasis for states, exceptions, and review priority without changing the underlying data.
representative_how: apply visual formatting based on status or threshold conditions
keep the rule tied to source cells instead of one-off manual color edits
concrete_workflows: mark overdue or high-risk rows for review
verification_strategy: Promote only after the verifier can inspect rule definitions or deterministic rendered cell formatting instead of assuming visual intent.
notes: Tracked separately from highlight_threshold because the research signal includes broader rule-based formatting, not only threshold highlights.
